title: Refresh /quit-smoking-with-nicotine-patch for "using nicotine patches" and "where to put a nicotine patch"
body:
URL: /quit-smoking-with-nicotine-patch
Cluster: nicotine patch to quit smoking
Type: refresh
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-10-27, GSC 2026-09-27..2026-10-24, inventory 2026-10-27

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner (US, monthly): "using nicotine patches to quit smoking" / "quit nicotine patches" 12,100 (LOW competition, 12-month trend up 1.8x). "where to put nicotine patch" and its variants 4,400 (LOW). "where is the best place to put a nicotine patch" 390. "nicotine replacement patch" 4,400 (LOW).
- The page has 645 words (inventory flag: thin), last modified 2026-10-13, no GSC impressions this window. It never says where to put the patch.
- SERP check (web search, 2026-10-27): the "where to put" results are mostly scraped or spam pages. A clear, sourced answer has room to rank.
- NRT is priority topic 3 in seo/blou-profile.md.

## Recommended action
Refresh in place to about 1,500 words: answer first (how to use a patch, which strength, how long), add an H2 "Where to put a nicotine patch" (hairless, clean, dry skin on upper arm, chest or back; rotate sites; what to avoid), a strength-by-cigarettes-per-day table linking to /tools/nicotine-patch-plan, sleep and vivid-dream tips (link /guides/dreams-and-sleep), and an FAQ from the placement queries. Sources: NHS, Smokefree.gov, MedlinePlus, FDA label wording. No dosing advice beyond the label and NHS/CDC guidance. Keep the URL; add "where to put nicotine patch" to keywords.
Do not create a separate placement page yet; one strong page avoids splitting a young domain's signals.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
The page is indexed and shows impressions for "where to put nicotine patch" and "nicotine patch to quit smoking" within 28 days of publishing, with an average position under 30.

title: Refresh /quit-smoking-with-bupropion for "Wellbutrin for quitting smoking"
body:
URL: /quit-smoking-with-bupropion
Cluster: wellbutrin bupropion to quit smoking
Type: refresh
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-10-27, inventory 2026-10-27

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner (US, monthly): "wellbutrin for quitting smoking" / "wellbutrin to stop smoking" 4,400 (LOW competition, trend up 1.2x). "bupropion for smoking cessation" / "bupropion stop smoking" 2,400 (LOW, up 1.5x). "wellbutrin and smoking" 1,300. "bupropion quit smoking dosage" 480.
- The page has 502 words (inventory flag: thin), last modified 2026-10-13, 0 GSC impressions. "Wellbutrin" appears 3 times but not in the title or H1.
- SERP check (web search, 2026-10-27): mostly scraped pages plus a 2006 news article. A current, sourced explainer can compete.

## Recommended action
Refresh to about 1,400 words. Put "Wellbutrin (bupropion)" in the title and H1. Answer first: what it is, that it needs a prescription, that it starts 1-2 weeks before the quit day, how it compares with varenicline and NRT. Add a timeline table (week -2 to week 12) with label-sourced points, a side-effects section that matches the FDA label and MedlinePlus, and an FAQ (can I smoke on Wellbutrin, Wellbutrin vs Zyban, with a patch). Sources: FDA label, MedlinePlus, NHS, CDC. Link to /quit-smoking-with-varenicline and /combination-nrt-quit-smoking.
Do not give dosing beyond the label. Do not suggest starting or stopping a prescription; always "ask your doctor". Risk: medical claims, so every figure needs a source.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
The page is indexed and ranks in the top 30 for "wellbutrin for quitting smoking" within 6 weeks of publishing.

title: Refresh /quit-smoking-help for "free nicotine patches"
body:
URL: /quit-smoking-help
Cluster: free nicotine patches
Type: refresh
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-10-27, GSC 2026-09-27..2026-10-24, inventory 2026-10-27

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner (US, monthly): "free nicotine patches" 2,900 (MEDIUM competition, trend up 1.2x). "free smoking patches" 1,000. "free nicotine patches online" 590. "free nicotine gum" 590. "1 800 quit now" 1,900.
- The hub already lists "free nicotine patches" first in its keywords but its title is "Free quit-smoking help by state + cigarette tax" and it has 2 GSC impressions (position 27.5). The 51 state pages under it have ~16 impressions at most (/quit-smoking-help/new-york, "nys quit smoking" at 25.4).
- High business fit: people looking for free patches are about to quit.

## Recommended action
Retitle and restructure the hub around "How to get free nicotine patches (by state)": answer first (call 1-800-QUIT-NOW; most state quitlines mail free NRT to eligible adults; Medicaid and most insurance cover NRT under the ACA), an eligibility note that rules vary by state, the state picker, and an FAQ (online ordering, how many weeks, gum and lozenges too). Sources: CDC (1-800-QUIT-NOW), each state quitline already in src/lib/stateQuitlines.ts, Smokefree.gov. Link to /quit-smoking-with-nicotine-patch and /tools/nicotine-patch-plan.
Risk: the hub is barely ranking, so a title change has little downside. Do not state that every state gives free patches; say "many" unless sourced per state.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
/quit-smoking-help gets 100+ impressions in 28 days with "free nicotine patches" queries in the top 30.

title: New page: what happens if you swallow a Zyn (/swallowed-a-zyn)
body:
URL: /swallowed-a-zyn
Cluster: swallowed a zyn pouch
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-10-27, inventory 2026-10-27

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner (US, monthly, LOW competition): "can you swallow zyn spit" 3,600; "what happens if you swallow a zyn pouch" 2,900; "what happens if you swallow a zyn" 2,400; "accidentally swallowed a zyn" 1,900; "do you swallow zyn spit" 1,900; "swallowed a zyn" 1,600; plus 15+ variants at 260-720.
- No existing page covers it (grep for "swallow" in src/app: none). /are-zyns-bad-for-you covers general health risks, not this intent.
- SERP check (web search, 2026-10-27): results are a brand blog and scraped spam pages. No NHS/CDC/poison-center page in the top results.
- Zyn/pouches is priority topic 2. Readers are current pouch users, a natural fit for /quit-zyn and the App Store CTA.

## Recommended action
Short answer page (about 1,000 words): answer first (one pouch in an adult usually causes stomach upset or nausea at most; a child or pet swallowing one is an emergency, call Poison Control 1-800-222-1222), symptoms to watch, what to do now, "should you swallow Zyn spit" (nicotine in saliva, hiccups and stomach irritation), and an FAQ from the query list. Sources: America's Poison Centers, CDC/NIOSH nicotine toxicity, FDA on nicotine pouches, MedlinePlus nicotine poisoning. Link to /quit-zyn, /zyn-withdrawal, /are-zyns-bad-for-you, /tools/nicotine-pouch-calculator.
Risk +2 (medical, poisoning). No mg thresholds without a source; no "it's harmless" wording; poison-control line above the fold.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Published, indexed, and ranks in the top 20 for "swallowed a zyn" within 6 weeks.

title: New page: nicotine replacement therapy for vaping (/nrt-for-vaping)
body:
URL: /nrt-for-vaping
Cluster: nicotine replacement therapy for vaping
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-10-27, inventory 2026-10-27

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner (US, monthly, LOW competition): "nicotine replacement therapy for vaping" 3,600 (12-month trend down to 0.45x, still large); "nicotine gum for quitting vaping" 720 (up 1.5x). Related: "best way to quit vaping" 2,900 (HIGH), "quitting vaping side effects" 1,600.
- Existing coverage: /quit-vaping (651 words, thin) mentions NRT 3 times; /combination-nrt-quit-smoking and /nrt-and-quit-smoking-app are about cigarettes. No page answers how to dose NRT when you vape, which is the hard part (vapes deliver more nicotine per day than most smokers get; salt nicotine).
- SERP check (web search, 2026-10-27): a 2025 PMC narrative review, Canadian provincial guidance PDFs, a pharmacy blog. Little consumer-friendly content.

## Recommended action
New article (about 1,500 words): answer first (NRT is used for vaping the same way as for smoking, often patch plus a fast-acting form; vaping-specific trials are still running), how to estimate your daily nicotine from pods (link /tools/nicotine-patch-plan), patch strength table, gum/lozenge for urges, timeline, under-18 note (talk to a doctor), FAQ. Sources: NHS Better Health, Smokefree.gov (teen and vaping), Truth Initiative, the 2025 PMC review, CDC. Link from /quit-vaping, /vape-withdrawal-symptoms and /quit-vaping-timeline.
Risk +2 (dosing). Do not present e-cigarettes as a quit method. Mark evidence as extrapolated from smoking cessation where it is.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Published, indexed, and ranks in the top 30 for "nicotine replacement therapy for vaping" within 6 weeks.

title: New landing page: quit vaping app (/quit-vaping-app), confirm vaping support first
body:
URL: /quit-vaping-app
Cluster: quit vaping app
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-10-27, inventory 2026-10-27

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner (US, monthly): "quit vaping app" 1,300 (MEDIUM competition, trend 0.54x). Commercial intent, closest to an App Store visit of any vaping query.
- No page targets it. /quit-vaping mentions "a tracker app" but is a how-to article. /best-quit-smoking-apps and /quit-smoking-app-for-iphone target smoking.
- Blocker: APP_FEATURES in src/lib/site.ts and seo/blou-profile.md do not say Blou supports vaping (puffs, pods or a vape-free counter). A landing page would make a product claim we cannot verify from the repo.

## Recommended action
Owner: confirm in the app what a vaper can track (quit date, money saved on pods, milestones). If supported, add it to APP_FEATURES and the profile, then move this to Todo: a landing page modeled on /quit-smoking-app-for-iphone with honest drawbacks (iPhone only, subscription) and links from /quit-vaping, /quit-vaping-timeline, /vape-withdrawal-symptoms. If not supported, cancel this issue.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief (after owner confirmation)

## Done when
Owner has confirmed vaping support and the page is live, or the issue is canceled.
